name: Does the client have the structure and scale for a transformation?  (CLIENT MATURITY)

criteria.question: Is there an existing incumbent?

scoring.1: There is no incumbent
scoring.2: There is an incumbent and they're the preferred supplier
scoring.3: There is an incumbent but we are unsure on the success of the project so far
scoring.4: There is an incumbent but the client has expressed interest in us bidding as they are unhappy with the current supplier
scoring.5: We are the incumbent

criteria.question: Is the organisation > 100 FTEs?  Or Finance > 150 FTEs?

scoring.1: No, <50FTEs
scoring.2: No, >50 FTEs
scoring.4: Yes, > 150 FTEs
scoring.5: Yes, > 200 FTEs

name: Has client identified a need to change? (CLIENT JUSTIFICATION)

criteria.question: Has an op model review been done/ in progress/planned?

scoring.1: There is no op model
scoring.2: There is plan to create an Op Model
scoring.3: There is an Op Model in progress
scoring.4: There is an Op Model
scoring.5: Op Model done and we've built it

criteria.question: Is a technology upgrade planned/ inflight?

scoring.1: There is no technology upgrade planned or inflight
scoring.2: There is a plan to upgrade technilogy in the future
scoring.4: There is a roadmap to upgrade technology but we've not seen it
scoring.5: Full technology roadmap that we helped build

criteria.question: Have they appointed a Leader?

scoring.1: There is no appointed leader/ we do not know if there is a leader
scoring.2: There is a plan to be appoint a leader
scoring.3: There is a leader but we don't know them
scoring.4: There is a leader and we've had occasional contact
scoring.5: There is a leader and we have a good relationship where we have the ability to gather intel on the opportunity

name: Has client taken steps to change? (EMOTIONAL & BUYING MOMENTUM)

criteria.question: Is there a compelling & recognised case for change?

scoring.1: We do not know/understand the business need for the solution
scoring.2: We know the business need but not not believe it to be pressing/compelling
scoring.3: We know the business need, it is compelling, but there are alternative approaches being considered by the customer
scoring.4: There is a pressing businesss need and the customer has no viable alternatives to accepting one of the offers submitted
scoring.5: There is a pressing business need for this solution and the potential for us to meet other business needs as a direct result of this proposal

name: Do we have strong relationships and coach (Political Ally)?  (RELATIONSHIP CONNECTIONS)

criteria.question: Do we have strong relationships? Do we know who makes the selection decision and how they will decide?

scoring.1: We do not know the decision makes, there is a stronf incumbent
scoring.2: We know who the decision makers are but have little to no relationship with them
scoring.3: We know the decision makers and the process. We have some supporters within the customer but so do our competitors
scoring.4: We know the decision makers and have good relationships with them. We believe we are strongly places
scoring.5: We have an excellent relationship with the decision mkaers who are coaching/supporting us in the process

criteria.question: Do we understand the competitive and political landscape?

scoring.1: No
scoring.2: We only understand the political or competitive landscape
scoring.3: We understand parts of the political and competitive landscape
scoring.4: We have an understanding of both the competitive and political landscape
scoring.5: We have a deep understanding of both the competitive and political landscape

name: Do we have strong reputation with the client?  (OUR REPUTATION)

criteria.question: Do we have a record of strong delivery within this area of the client?

scoring.1: No, we have no record of delivery with this client
scoring.2: No, we have an unsuccessful record of delivery with this client
scoring.3: We have some record of strong delivery with this client and also some bad
scoring.4: Yes, we have a strong record of delivery with some slightly troubled delivery
scoring.5: Yes, we have a strong record of delivery

criteria.question: Have IBM been involved in any transformation work in the last 2 years with this area of the client?

scoring.1: No, IBM have not been involved in any transformation work
scoring.2: Yes, but it was unsuccessful
scoring.3: We have completed transformation work within the last 2 years, however, there were some issues with the delivery
scoring.4: We have completed successful transformation work within the last 2 years that has a good reputation
scoring.5: Yes, we are currently involved in transformation work and it has a good reputation

criteria.question: Does IBM have a good reputation in this industry?

scoring.1: No, IBM has a poor reputation in this industry
scoring.2: No, IBM has no reputation in this industry
scoring.3: IBM has a reasonably good reputation in this industry with some issues in the past
scoring.4: IBM has a good reputation in this industry with with no major issues
scoring.5: Yes, IBM has an excellent reputation of delivery in this industry and are a trusted advisor for our clients

criteria.question: Do we have  specialism/ regulatory expertise and/or relevant product in the industry, e.g., promontory,  Pharma, drug dev. approval and release criteria.

scoring.1: We have no specialism/ regulatory expertise and/or relevant product in the industry
scoring.2: We have a relevant   specialism/ regulatory expertise and/or relevant product in the industry but the client do not want to utilise it
scoring.3: We have a relevant   specialism/ regulatory expertise and/or relevant product in the industry but the client are currently unaware
scoring.4: We have a relevant   specialism/ regulatory expertise and/or relevant product in the industry and the client will consider it
scoring.5: We have a relevant   specialism/ regulatory expertise and/or relevant product in the industry and we're the only ones who can provide it

name: Do we have a differentiator relevant to the industry? (SOLUTION DIFFERENTIATORS)

criteria.question: Do we have clear differentiators that are relevant to the industry or client?

scoring.1: We do not have any unique propositions relevant to this opportunity
scoring.2: We believe we have some differentiatior but have not confirmed this with the client, we do not know our competitors differentiators
scoring.3: We know our differentiations and our competitors
scoring.4: We know our differentiations and our competitors and confirmed with the customer
scoring.5: We know our differentiations and our competitors. The customer has incorporated some of our USPs into their requirements

criteria.question: Do we have an existing solution/product that closely matches the customer's requirement?

scoring.1: We do not have a solution that meets their requirements
scoring.2: Our solutions and services meet some of the requirement but there are significant gaps
scoring.3: Our solutions meet most of the requirement but require significant customisation or development to do so
scoring.4: Our solution meets most of the requirement with little or no change, and all of the requirement with some customisation
scoring.5: Our solution meets all of the requirements with no significant change

criteria.question: How do we stack up against the competition?

scoring.1: We do not know who tye other bidders are
scoring.2: We know who the other bidders are, some are capable and credible. One of them is the incumbent
scoring.3: We know who the other bidders are. We believe that we are the strongest. One of the other bidders is the incumbent.
scoring.4: We are the incumbent or the customer has voiced clear intent to replace the incumbent. We know the other bidders and believe we are the strongest
scoring.5: We are the only bidder or know all otheres are weak/uncompetitive. We are the incumbent

name: Do we understand the client’s buying process?  (KNOWLEDEGE OF DECISION MAKING PROCESS)

criteria.question: Are the timecales for the bid manageable?

scoring.1: We do not know the customer timescales
scoring.2: We know the customer timescales ad they do not fit with our sales cycle. There is insufficient time for QA and review
scoring.3: We know the customers timescales, and they do not fit within our sales cycle. We must re-assign resource from other bids to meet the timelines
scoring.4: The timescale are realistic and allow for review and QA of the proposal. We ca resource the bid without disruption
scoring.5: The timescales are realistic for us and we know that the competition will struggle to meet them.

criteria.question: Is the opportunity the right size?

scoring.1: The opportunity is too small to be profitable, or more than 10 times the size of the nearest comparable win
scoring.2: The opportunity is too small to be profitable, or more than 5 times the size of the nearest comparable win
scoring.3: The opportunity is small, but opens the door for large opportunities, or more than 3 times the size of the nearest comparable win
scoring.4: The opportunity is within the range of comparable wins in this service area
scoring.5: The opportunity is within the range of comparable wins in this service area, and is strategically important in developing new lines of business

criteria.question: Can we price our solution within the customer's budget?

scoring.1: We do not know the customer's budget
scoring.2: We have an idea of the customer's budget, but it is unrealistic/we will not be able to meet it
scoring.3: We know the customer's budget. We think it will be unlikely we will be within it
scoring.4: We know the customer's budget. We think we will be close to it (either above or below)
scoring.5: We know the customer's budget and are confident that we will be within it

criteria.question: Do we have the relevant commercial Framework/ rate card in place compared to our competition?

scoring.1: We are not on the customer's commercial framework
scoring.2: We are on the commercial framework but do not have a competitive ratecard
scoring.4: We are on the commercial framework and have won work with this customer with the ratecard
scoring.5: We are on the commercial framework and have won work with this customer with the ratecard as it it more competitive than our competition

criteria.question: Does this deal involve Transfer of Aquired Rights (TUPE)

scoring.1: TUPE is involved and not capped
scoring.2: Tupe is involved with over 10 people in scope
scoring.3: Tupe is involved with 5-10 people in scope
scoring.4: Tupe is involved with less than 5 people in scope
scoring.5: No TUPE
